Night Market Eating
Jan 2018 • Family
Thao Nguyen is one of about eight restaurants in the food court of the Nha Trang Night Market.

There were six of us, including my three granddaughters.

We had coconut chicken, which as the name implies came in a coconut topped with crunchy red, yellow and green capsicum pieces. We had stir fried morning glory with garlic, pork ribs with garlic, and grilled pork ribs with five spice, stir fried duck breast, and as a concession to the girls, a pizza.

I would rate the coconut chicken and the duck as the best dishes, but the pork spare ribs were a big disappointment. They were as tough as old shoe leather and it was difficult to differentiate between the ribs with garlic and the ribs with five spice.

With some fresh coconuts for the kids and Saigon Beer for my son and I, the bill was VND 720,000.

Absolutely NOT recommendable
Mar 2017 • Couples
I don't know where all the good reviews were from. We had grilled chicken and beef steak and Nem Nuong Nha Trang. The food wasn't good at all. I've never had such terrible beef steak like that before. The Nem Nuong Nha Trang was definitely not that of 'Nha Trang' and was cooked in such a careless way that it tasted not like NEM at all, but simply grilled meat. We were two persons, but my bf got his grilled chicken served only after I had finished my steak, just because they forgot our order. They even forgot our drink. The white rice portion coming with the chicken wasn't even hot anymore. Could you imagine the situation where a couple went dinner together and my bf had to watch me eat first and I him afterwards? So weird.
As we came the waiter was having a fight with the woman in the kitchen. Since we understand Vietnamese, our mood was partially, and after the meal, in combination with the food quality - totally destroyed. I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone and of course will never, ever, come back.
